name: Prepare 1 L of 1× TBS from 10× stock
description: Dilute 100 mL of 10× Tris-buffered saline (TBS) stock to 1 L with lab water and verify pH 7.6 ± 0.1 at room temperature (~22 °C). A realistic wet-lab SOP that exercises volume and pH measurement criteria; satisfied judgments on those criteria require instrument or display-readout evidence, not visual estimate alone.

steps.title: Gather materials on the bench
steps.instruction: Place the 10× TBS stock bottle, a 1 L graduated cylinder, a clean 1 L storage bottle, and a calibrated pH meter with electrode on the bench.

success_criteria.description: graduated cylinder upright on the bench with stock, bottle, and pH meter beside it

failure_modes.description: stock, cylinder, bottle, or pH meter not visible on the bench

safety_notes: Wear a lab coat, safety glasses, and nitrile gloves.
Confirm the pH meter was calibrated the same day with pH 7.00 and pH 4.00 (or 10.00) buffers.

steps.title: Measure 100 mL of 10× TBS stock
steps.instruction: Pour 100 mL of 10× TBS stock into the 1 L graduated cylinder. Read the meniscus at eye level on the 100 mL mark.

success_criteria.description: stock liquid visible in the cylinder near the 100 mL mark

failure_modes.description: volume clearly below 98 mL or above 102 mL

steps.title: Dilute to 1 L with lab water
steps.instruction: Add lab water (or ultrapure water) to the cylinder until the meniscus reaches the 1 L mark. Mix by gentle inversion after transferring to the storage bottle, or stir in the cylinder if using a stir bar.

success_criteria.description: cylinder filled to the 1 L mark

failure_modes.description: water or buffer spilled during dilution

steps.title: Verify pH 7.6 ± 0.1 at room temperature
steps.instruction: Transfer a small aliquot to a clean beaker if required by your meter. Insert the calibrated electrode, wait for a stable reading, and record the pH. Accept 7.5–7.7 at approximately 22 °C. Adjust with dilute HCl or NaOH only if outside that range and lab policy allows.

success_criteria.description: pH meter electrode immersed and display showing a stable reading

failure_modes.description: meter reading unstable or electrode not immersed

safety_notes: Rinse the electrode with lab water before and after immersion; blot dry — do not wipe the bulb.

steps.title: Transfer, label, and store
steps.instruction: Transfer the 1× TBS into the storage bottle. Label with name (1× TBS), concentration, pH, preparation date, expiry (typically 1–3 months at 4 °C per lab policy), and preparer initials.

success_criteria.description: label visible with name, pH, date, and initials
storage bottle contains the prepared 1× TBS

failure_modes.description: label missing name, pH, date, or initials

safety_notes: Store at 4 °C unless lab SOP specifies otherwise. Discard if cloudy or contaminated.
